name: Prepare for intake
activity: Prepare the intake environment, verify access to required tracking resources and organize documentation for the session.
control: Use a preparation checklist and record access or readiness issues for escalation.

name: Capture intake and attendance
activity: Collect intake and attendance information at the point of capture. Support accurate data entry for assessment and consent documentation.
control: Confirm required fields are complete and use consistent session identifiers.

name: Validate and resolve
activity: Check records for completeness and accuracy. Identify discrepancies, follow up with the appropriate advisor and resolve data-capture issues within role scope.
control: Separate validated records from records requiring follow-up. Maintain an aggregate exception count.

name: Digitize and organize
activity: Scan paper documentation, apply consistent file names and organize records in authorized shared locations. Carry out routine file and system cleanup.
control: Follow agreed file naming, access and retention procedures. Keep personal records within approved organizational systems.

name: Prepare reporting
activity: Maintain reliable datasets to support recurring program monitoring and service planning. Prepare reporting-ready summaries for the appropriate team.
control: Reconcile aggregate counts and record preparation time before handoff.
